zoe (Design): mock attached — quick review please: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2168123456_v1.png
zoe (Design): TL;DR: trying a compact token readout that sits next to the timestamp, and three options for Stop/Regenerate: inline action row, floating top-right button, or a mini-toolbar that appears on hover. Also exploring drag-in affordance for the prompt library. thoughts?
mike (Product): mini-toolbar on hover seems clean, reduces noise for most users. would want a persistent accessible way to trigger actions via keyboard though.
sam (Eng): mini-toolbar is doable. implementation notes: keep Stop/Regenerate stateless on the client (send cancel token to backend). For keyboard a11y: provide a focusable message actions button (e.g., 3-dots) that opens a menu with Stop / Regenerate. For streaming aria: use aria-live region — consider `aria-live="polite"` for token updates, but announce final with `assertive` when response completes.
nana (Research): token counter: show a running integer for total tokens (no decimals). add a compact mode that only shows token delta for the request. hover tooltip should show breakdown: prompt tokens / completion tokens / cached tokens.
claire (QA): a11y nits from testing: token badge color fails contrast at small sizes (currently ~3:1). Need >=4.5:1 for body text. Also screen readers get noisy because each chunk gets announced; should announce once at start ("Response streaming") and then final readout. Also verify reduced-motion respects OS prefs for stream animations.
zoe (Design): copy question: label actions as "Stop/Regenerate" vs "Stop generation / Regenerate response". which is clearer? proposing keyboard shortcuts: Esc to stop, Cmd/Ctrl+R to regenerate (but aware of browser conflict).
mike (Product): prefer explicit copy: "Stop generation" / "Regenerate response" — clearer for new users. Cmd/Ctrl+R will clash with browser reload; maybe use Shift+R or allow focus-scoped shortcuts (only active when message panel has focus).
sam (Eng): agree on conflicts. We'll scope shortcuts to the conversation DOM node so global browser shortcuts aren't overridden. Implementation note: Stop should call cancel endpoint and also set client-side cancel flag to stop rendering. Regen should snapshot current convo state and re-emit prompt.
nana (Research): prompt library drag-in: need clear visual drop target and insertion affordance. For keyboard/screenreader users expose an "Insert prompt" button on each card and a "Preview" action. Proposed keyboard binding: press `p` when a library card is focused to preview, Enter to insert.
claire (QA): test matrix additions: streaming + stop under high-latency (packet loss emulation), ensure server cancels generation to avoid runaway costs. Screenreader flow: NVDA/VoiceOver tests for announce-on-start + final content. Contrast checks for token badge at 12px.
zoe (Design): updated mock v2 with contrast fixes and ARIA annotations: https://redwood.design/snapshots/2168123456_v2.png
zoe (Design): decided to change copy to "Stop generation" and "Regenerate response" and move the token badge left of the timestamp so action buttons stay grouped. Will iterate on hover timing and reduced-motion alternatives.
sam (Eng): I'll prototype the actions menu + keyboard scoping this sprint. I'll add an automated e2e to send cancel and verify backend cancellation header is set. cc @ana for prompt lib drop target spec.
ux-bot: Reminder — design review scheduled Wed 10:30am PT. Attach final mocks to the review doc before EOD Tue. :spiral_calendar_pad:
